title: Uniqueness of Flotation and Buoyancy Surfaces for Convex Polytopes
summary: We prove that a convex polytope $P \subset \mathbb{R}^d$, $d \ge 2$, of uniform density $δ\in (0,1)$ floating in a liquid of density $1$, is uniquely determined by its surface of flotation $P_{[δ]}$ whenever $δ\neq \tfrac{1}{2}$. Analogously, we show that the buoyancy surface $\mathcal{C}_δP$ of a convex polytope $P$ with prescribed density $δ\in (0,1)$ uniquely determines $P$.
